name: Horde FPS
author: TomoTT
description:
You have to be really bored and in ultimate procrastination mode in order to attempt this wee game. 

Horde FPS is a simple zombie shooter. Select your area (Down Town currently available) and try to survive the horde.

Highscore is currently only available in DL version available here. https://tomott.itch.io/horde-fps
